metadata.description: Role plugins for building Montezuma 3D. Each plugin is one job on the port: its agent, skills and the paths it owns.

plugins.name: montezuma-common
plugins.description: Shared rules every role loads: clean-room asset policy, repo layout, contracts, and how to pick up a work package.

plugins.name: gameplay-engineer
plugins.description: Pure GDScript game logic in core/: board, totems, bonuses, progression, with headless tests.

plugins.name: level-designer
plugins.description: Rules spec, level data for all episodes, difficulty curve and balance simulation.

plugins.name: board-presentation
plugins.description: The 3D board scene: camera, input, swap/match/cascade animation and game feel.

plugins.name: asset-artist
plugins.description: Original 3D models, materials and shaders, generated by script with recorded provenance.

plugins.name: audio-designer
plugins.description: Original sound effects, music and ambience, and the cue player that plays them.

plugins.name: ui-engineer
plugins.description: HUD, menus, episode map, trophies screen and settings in Godot Control nodes.

plugins.name: release-engineer
plugins.description: CI, export presets and builds for desktop, web, Android and iOS.
